    update() - Method in class logic.MoneyManager
    Advances passive money generation by one frame (called ~60 times per second).
    update() - Method in class models.base.AoeUnit
    Per-frame AI loop: Runs Unit.updateAnimation() to advance sprites and death phases. Returns early if the unit is dead or dying. Collects all targets in range; if any are found, starts the attack animation and stores the full target list for frame-3 AoE damage. If no targets are found, walks forward.
    update() - Method in class models.base.CannonWave
    Advances the wave by one game-loop frame.
    update() - Method in class models.base.SingleTargetUnit
    Per-frame AI loop: Runs Unit.updateAnimation() to advance sprites and death phases. Returns early if the unit is dead or dying. Finds a target; if found, starts the attack animation and locks the target for frame-3 damage delivery. If no target is found, walks forward.
    update() - Method in class models.base.Tower
    Towers have no per-frame AI; this method is intentionally empty.
    update() - Method in class models.base.Unit
    Per-frame logic hook.
    update() - Method in class models.units.UFOCat
    Per-frame AI loop with two phases: Wave-active phase: fires one wave step every 150 ms until all three steps are complete, then clears the wave flag. Normal phase: looks for targets in the full 210 px range; when found and the cooldown has elapsed, starts the wave sequence by immediately firing wave step 0.
    updateAnimation() - Method in class models.base.Unit
    Drives the sprite state machine every frame.
    updateStage(ArrayList, double) - Method in class models.stages.GameStage
    Called once per game-loop frame.
    updateState(int) - Method in class ui.CatButton
    Refreshes the affordability overlay based on the player's current money.
    updateState(int) - Method in class ui.LevelUpButton
    Refreshes the button's enabled/disabled state and icon opacity based on whether the player can currently afford the upgrade.
    upgradeWallet() - Method in class logic.MoneyManager
    Upgrades the wallet to the next level if the player has enough money and the wallet is not already at MoneyManager.MAX_LEVEL.
